reviews.decision_reason: select_demand keeps all supplied demand records: every input record has demand_score >= 3, and the output needs contain the same eight record_ids with their need/source fields preserved.

normalize_evidence retains the allowed record_ids and required columns, producing the eight normalized needs consumed by the downstream job. No contradictory semantic-only evidence shows dropped or unrelated candidates.

assemble_provenance produces the deterministic evidence handoff used by the downstream priority job: ranks place n06-r07 ahead of n06-r01, which supports the final required recommendation to prioritize recomputing downstream jobs after an upstream repair. This ordering is visible in the assigned output and is not contradicted by the supplied package.
